guard: a focus-mode ack-dropped ambient/@mention on a channel recall cannot actually replay (replay=off, or reachable only via a wildcard join) is reported in `droppedChannels`, not silently claimed as an empty-but-complete window
why: #977: focus-mode ingest ack-drops channel ambient and @mentions on the documented promise that
they "stay recallable via cotal_inbox (recallAmbient)". That promise silently failed in two
independent places: `recallChannel` returned `dropped: false` for a replay=off channel (an empty
array read as a complete, empty window), and `recallAmbient` `continue`d past a wildcard-joined
channel before it ever reached the `droppedChannels` push. Either way `cotal_inbox` told the
reader nothing was lost when a message -- possibly an @mention with no other delivery path -- was
TWO SITES, TWO CELLS, GRADED FROM TWO SUITES ON PURPOSE. The fix has no shared code path: one
mutation reverts `packages/core/src/endpoint.ts`'s `recallChannel` replay gate and is graded by
`attention.smoke.ts` (its cell already covers the replay=off channel); the other reverts
`extensions/connector-core/src/agent.ts`'s wildcard skip in `recallAmbient` and is graded by the
dedicated `focus-recall-wildcard.smoke.ts`, since no existing suite joins a channel only through a
wildcard while in focus. Each mutation names the suite that actually exercises it.
BUILD FIRST FOR THE CORE MUTATION, REBUILD ON RESTORE. `attention.smoke.ts` resolves
`@cotal-ai/core` through `dist/`, so mutating `endpoint.ts` under `src` is invisible to it without
a build; `afterRestore` rebuilds core so the tree is not left compiled from the mutant. The
`agent.ts` mutation needs no build: connector-core's own smoke suites import `../src/agent.js`

mutations.name: recallChannel stops reporting the replay=off gate, so an ack-dropped channel reads as an empty, complete window
mutations.expectRed: recall REPORTS the replay=off channel as dropped, not silently
mutations.cell: recall REPORTS the replay=off channel as dropped, not silently
mutations.note: The defect exactly as it shipped: `recallChannel` still correctly returns no messages for a replay=off channel (the gate itself holds -- the sibling cell `recall GATES OUT the replay=off channel` stays green), but claims the window was complete instead of naming the channel in `droppedChannels`.

mutations.name: recallAmbient goes back to silently skipping a wildcard-joined channel instead of naming it dropped
mutations.expectRed: recall REPORTS the wildcard join as dropped, not silently
mutations.cell: recall REPORTS the wildcard join as dropped, not silently
mutations.note: The other independent cause of the same silent loss: a channel reached only through a wildcard subscription (`team.>`) is not a concrete channel `recallChannel` can be asked about, so before the fix the loop `continue`d past it with nothing recorded -- the ambient and the @mention it ack-dropped at ingest vanish with no trace in `droppedChannels`.
